findings.summary: Tree create and move build invalid sort keys that focused tests miss.
findings.details: The backend SortKey schema requires ten digits, but the web adapter sends three-digit sort keys for new pages and moves. This means the required tree create/move UI paths will hit ValidationFailed instead of the intended mutations, while the focused tests still pass because they do not validate the adapter mutation args against the Confect/page schema.

findings.summary: Brain workspace feature constructs Convex function refs directly instead of using the adapter boundary.
findings.details: The task explicitly says generated refs are used only in the adapter, and the layer law keeps client/ref wiring at the hook/adapter boundary. The workspace feature imports convex/server and calls makeFunctionReference for editorSync operations itself, so the feature component owns transport refs that should be supplied through the adapter/client-hook seam.
